user.title: Home Intercom
user.description: Rooms are managed in the PWA (Settings → Rooms). You can add speakers after this step.

abort.no_media_players: No media_player entities found in Home Assistant.
abort.already_configured: Home Intercom is already configured. Add or edit rooms in the PWA.

init.title: 管理音箱与预设
init.description: 选择预设播报文字管理，或选择房间进行编辑。已配置 {room_count} 个房间。

add_room.title: Add Room
add_room.description: Select area and media player. Room name defaults to area name.

edit_room.title: Edit Room — {room_name}
edit_room.description: Change the media player entity for this room. Set volume/buffer to 0 to use defaults.

presets.title: 预设播报文字管理
presets.description: 仅 HA 管理员可维护。这里与家庭广播仪表盘共享同一份预设。

preset_edit.title: 编辑预设播报文字
preset_edit.description: 名称 1–30 字，内容 1–500 字。保存后所有家庭广播页面同步更新。

preset_delete.title: 删除预设
preset_delete.description: 勾选确认后删除此预设。不勾选则返回列表。

error.room_exists: A room with this area is already configured.
error.preset_invalid: 保存失败：请检查名称及内容长度；如其他设备已更新，请取消返回列表后重新编辑。
